pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:182 readStrip calls countEvents once per day over 84 days. Each call runs a total, a head and two statements for each of seven facets (16 statements in its own read transaction), so one render issues about 1,344 count statements to draw one per-day actor-kind bar series that a single grouped read could answer.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:182 A loop of per-item reads (for each day at read.ts:175). It computes all seven facets when only actorKind is used, and no test sets a query-count ceiling.
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:6 The screen issues no SQL: every read goes through the kernel's named query and count operations.
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:232 Display reads return a consumer-shaped, read-only projection (page, facets, strip) that is never written back.
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/filter.ts:74 URL tokens are mapped onto closed vocabularies and passed to the kernel as a structured query. No query text is assembled here.

pairs.evidence: lib/import/runs.ts:65 The import module writes raw SQL against kernel tables and even the JSON path inside the jobs record, so a kernel schema or record-shape change has consumers in lib/import that the kernel cannot enumerate.

techniques.evidence: lib/import/runs.ts:65 Statements naming physical tables and columns live outside the data layer, also at project.ts:211, shelf.ts:171, export.ts:64 and commit.ts:273.
lib/import/commit.ts:45 Content-addressed blobs (dependent) land before the rows that reference them (authority), so a rollback leaves only unreferenced, reusable files.
lib/import/commit.ts:270 There is one boundary per project, owned by the code that knows the invariant. afterLanded runs only after commit (commit.ts:277).
lib/import/archive.ts:164 The archive read fails whole on any bad line. The run sources degrade visibly instead, recording each unreadable run's identity and error (runSources.ts:74).
lib/import/project.ts:211 Statements are static with bound values. There is no interpolation.
tests/next-server/import-roundtrip.test.ts:50 A real migrated SQLite file and a real blob store in a temp dir.

pairs.evidence: lib/steps/readStep.ts:39 loadStep, exported on the step store's door, answers a FAILED single-record read with the seeded default, the same answer as never-written. A caller that saves after it overwrites the stored record, which is the bug patchStep's header describes.

techniques.evidence: lib/steps/readStep.ts:39 A single-record read must keep failure distinct from absence. The decode seam itself is sound (recordRegistry.ts:168 refuses malformed and future records). grep finds no production caller of loadStep outside lib/steps, only tests/golden-path/dal-real-engine.probe.spec.ts, but it is still on the door (index.ts:56).
lib/steps/patchStep.ts:53 Read-modify-write runs in one readwrite transaction. A throw in decide aborts it.
lib/steps/index.ts:30 One door re-exports named operations. The connection helper withStore is not exported on it.
tests/golden-path/dal-real-engine.probe.spec.ts:26 Tests run against a spec-complete IndexedDB engine, not a mock of the repo's calls, and state their quota-coverage limit.
lib/steps/saveOrder.ts:58 Latest-wins is a per-tab in-memory ticket over one store. No stream spans stores with different durability, so the token technique's precondition does not hold.
lib/steps/withStore.ts:18 Key-value IndexedDB with no query language. The one key builder is the single authority.
